notes.title: Update 1.4 is now Live - The Showdown!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The last update for Hyperlight Survivor is now available!

This update will be the biggest one yet! New weapons, spaceships and a new rank. Also a lot of Quality of life improvements and a total rework of the game balance. I've worked very hard on this update and I hope you'll enjoy it! 

Also, this was my first commercial project ever so I want to thank everyone who supported the game, hope you liked it! 

Can't wait to show you my next works, in the meantime, you can follow my game developer journey here: Follow Me Here!

Here's the changelog:

Weapons
New Weapon: Shock Missile
"Shoots a modified missile equipped with lightning cannons"

New Weapon: Medcharge
"Drops a charge that releases up to 5 medpacks on detonation"

Ships
New Spaceship: Tempest
Ultra: Nova Charge
"Shoots a supercharged Shock Missile that releases six Grapple Missiles on impact"

New Spaceship: Punisher
Ultra: Endbringer
"Overcharge the ship to generate a Plasma Shield and activates the Front Missile Cannons"


Interceptor Ultra cost reduced 20% 
Harbinger Ultra cost reduced 15% 
Heavy Sentry heals 3 HP every 6 seconds (instead of 5)
Ship Upgrades now unlocks exclusively by ranking
Destroyer ship now unlocks by reaching Silver I


Contracts Balance

Hard Contracts grants 20% more points
The Reckoning contract penalty decreased 20%
Reappearance contract penalty decreased 13%
Sector Survival Extreme difficulty timer reduced to 10 minutes (instead of 15)



Events

 Spawner Event is now easier to beat


Improvements

White Transition Effect darkened
Arena's obstacles are 10% smaller
Enemies spawners from Medium to Extreme difficulty have been reworked


Ranks
New Rank: GODLIKE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44461989/afcacc44ae96f04100c83b476d5011f25cfe8df7.gif

That's all for Hyperlight Survivor!

See you soon!
Witt

notes.title: Update 1.3 is now Live - New Event & New Weapon
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

A new update for Hyperlight Survivor is now available! 

This update will include a brand new event "Asteroids Rain". Survive incoming asteroids that will bounce across the arena and split into smaller parts once being destroyed. It will also include a new Weapon, the Grenade Launcher! Shoot a powerful explosive charge to destroy multiple targets!

Here's the changelog:

Events
New In-game Event: Asteroids Rain
"Approaching a belt of asteroids, destroy them"

Weapons
New weapon: Grenade Launcher
"Shoots an explosive charge that detonates on impact"

Balance
Medium Contracts Balanced

Bugfix
Fix: Player doesn't have a starting weapon during the tutorial

See you soon!
Witt

notes.title: Update 1.2.1 is now Live - Balance
notes.content:
Balance

 Medium Contracts Balanced
 Excessive Arsenal now requires 200 Weapon Box (instead of 250) to unlock
 Square Gunners take more time to spawn
 Reapers health decreased from 15 to 12
 The arena with four turrets has been reworked
 Weapon Boxes now spawn more frequently

notes.title: Update 1.2 is now Live - New Contract & Alternative Controls!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

A new update for Hyperlight Survivor is now available! Here's the changelog:

Enemies
New enemy type: Reapers
Advanced spaceships equipped with bullet cannons, powerful missiles and a nanoswarm charge that detonates once the ship gets destroyed.

Contracts
New Contract type: "Fear The Reaper" 
"The Designated Sector is currently under attack by a squadron of advanced spaceships, the Reapers. Stop them".


Balance
Medium Contracts spawners balanced

Improvements
Alternative controls for Keyboard: 
WASD = Move
M = Use Ultra

See you soon!
Witt

notes.title: Update 1.1 is now Live - New Enemy Type & Balance!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

First of all, thanks for the positive reception that the game is receiving, that means a lot!

This first update will introduce a new enemy type: The Square Gunner!. You will find it at the beginning of your runs in Medium and Hard Contracts.

Here's the full Changelog:

Enemies

 New Enemy Type: Square Gunner


Balance

 Interceptor Ultra cost reduced 5%
 Destroyer Ultra cost increased 5%
 Destroyer speed increased 10%
 Mines deployment time decreased 30%


Reworks

 Firewall Event Arena Reworked


That's all for this first update!

See you soon!
Witt

notes.title: Hyperlight Survivor Launch Date!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

It is with immense pleasure that I announce that Hyperlight Survivor is ready and that it will be released on November 17th! I worked very hard on this game and I can't wait to share it with you!
 
Meanwhile here's some of the game features:

 4 Unique Spaceships to Unlock and Upgrade
 5 - 30 minutes missions for shorts gameplay sessions
 Unique mission types with 4 different difficulty modes
 Ranking System
 A Vast Arsenal of weapons to destroy your opponets
 Different Power-Ups that will facilitate your Survival
 Cards System with special upgrades for your Weapons and Power-Ups
 Different Arenas full of Threats that change continuously during your run


Also, here's the Launch Trailer to have a closer look at the game!

notes.title: Welcome to Hyperlight Survivor!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44461989/b8be66e8087d9c250a5d2a76dd44ed64df865d25.gif

Competitive Bullet Hell!

Fight against endless hordes of enemies in ever-changing arenas, unlock new spaceships and upgrade them with devastating weapons and Power-Ups. Beat your highscore and reach new ranks to become the ultimate Champion! 

Some of the game features

 Competitive System
 Fast-paced Bullet Hell with roguelite mechanics
 Multiple spaceships to unlock, each one with a different Ultra Attack
 Ever-changing Arenas


If you're interested and want to know more about the game, consider to Wishlist and Follow!
